overall: The AG found the Revere Retirement Board violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session under Purpose 3 (litigation) to discuss a disability retirement application, which was not litigation strategy and belonged in open session. The Board was ordered to comply and release the April 29 executive session minutes within 30 days, without redaction.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board entered executive session at its April 29 meeting for an improper purpose, citing litigation strategy (Purpose 3).
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board's discussion did not fit within any of the ten enumerated purposes for executive session, this discussion should have occurred during open session.

remedy: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
We order the Board to publicly release the minutes of its April 29 executive session within thirty (30) days of receipt of this letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Board that a similar, future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law. Additionally, we order the Board to publicly release the minutes of its April 29 executive session within thirty (30) days of receipt of this letter.
